capabilities: Theme Mermaid and PlantUML blocks with 9 built-in styles
Override theme and canvas background per block with directives
Opt individual blocks out to Obsidian's built-in renderer
Toggle per-page watermark-free preview with a Pro or Premium account
Bake watermark-free or anonymous share URLs into notes for readers without the plugin
extras: Free tier renders are watermarked and capped at 10 KB source; all rendering by default sends diagram source to api.beauty-diagram.com (self-hostable via API base URL setting); Live Preview is not supported yet, so theming only shows in Reading View.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Mermaid renderer offers one plain look and PlantUML has no built-in renderer at all, so diagrams in notes look unpolished and dark-mode contrast is unreliable.

relations.evidence: PlantUML supported too, with the same theming pipeline. No local Java required.

requires.name: Beauty Diagram Pro or Premium plan

summary: Renders Mermaid and PlantUML code blocks with 9 themed styles and can bake portable share URLs into notes.
